name: start-up
description: Monorepo for the wholesale app: a **NestJS** API and **Next.js** web client.

scripts.start:dev: npm run start:backend & npm run start:web
scripts.start:prod: npm run build && (npm run start:backend:prod & npm run start:web:prod)
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:web

author: Rahul Rana
